segments.text: okay so the thing I keep coming back to is pricing
like I know the backend costs about twenty cents an hour
but I don't know if people will pay seven dollars
I guess what I'm really asking is whether the free tier is too generous
three sessions a month is a lot if each one costs me money
but if it's less than that nobody gets hooked
so maybe the answer is cap the prompts not the sessions
yeah I think that's the decision
